title: Globex Q4 2025 earnings call
text:
Operator: Good afternoon and welcome to the Globex earnings call.

CEO: This was a challenging quarter. Revenue declined 7% as our largest customer delayed orders. We are lowering guidance for the first half.

CFO: Gross margin compressed 310 basis points due to under-utilization of our fabs and higher freight costs. We drew on the revolver and paused the buyback to preserve liquidity.

Analyst: How confident are you in the second-half recovery?

CEO: Frankly, visibility is limited. Channel inventory remains elevated and we expect pricing pressure to continue.
